1.note: No coherent axis; durability is the most abstract-property noun of the four but this is near-random.

2.note: sentimental is off-register for an academic frame and empirical is the over-obvious default, leaving the specific logistical.

3.note: faithful/exacting/literal are one family (strict fidelity); idiomatic is the single contrasting pole a translation passage builds toward.

4.note: All four are dismissive critiques with no separating axis; picked the one that describes rather than devalues.

5.note: Only option that completes the standing evolutionary collocation (selective advantage); the others are bare nouns.

6.note: invites is the one metaphorical/figurative verb among three literal ones, the kind of usage a words-in-context item targets.

7.note: Chronology set; coeval is the rare high-register term and the direct antonym of successive, so it is the tested member.

8.note: Evidence-status set; provisional is the standard hedge an academic passage lands on, incontrovertible is too strong to be a key.

9.note: premonitory is off-register and ubiquitous is unrelated; dispositive is the precise term for evidence that settles a question.

10.note: Transmission-of-craft set; picked the concrete odd one out, but no real signal.

11.note: Three verbs take a flaw/error as object; obeyed is the only one whose object is a rule or convention.

12.note: unusual/imaginary/irrelevant are general dismissals; unmeasured is the one technical, quantitative term.

13.note: incomplete/unwarranted/premature all say 'not yet established'; circular names a specific named fallacy and is the odd axis.

14.note: Standard 'suggestive but not decisive' frame; decisive is the strength pole the other three do not occupy.

15.note: academic carries the polysemous 'of no practical consequence' sense these items like; the others are literal descriptors of a question.

16.note: accidental is off-axis (cause, not course) but nothing separates reversible/predictable/gradual.

17.note: decay/evaporation/drainage are all loss-of-material processes; settlement is the distinct compaction term and the odd member.

18.note: forgotten/surpassed/abandoned are three near-synonymous fates of a discarded idea; outgrown is the single metaphor.

19.note: machinery is concrete and prosperity is the opposite pole; split between frugality and spareness with no basis.

20.note: Only chronicle takes a record-of-events as its natural object; discern/publicize/instruct do not share that frame.

21.note: preserved/translated/disciplined all presuppose a pre-existing thing; invented is the contrasting claim such a passage builds toward.
